examples.title: Hi-res starburst
examples.description: 126 lines fan out from the middle of the 280 by 160 hi-res screen in green and violet, orange and blue, drawn with Applesoft's HGR, HCOLOR and HPLOT ... TO.

examples.title: Prime checker
examples.description: Type a whole number and the //e tells you whether it is prime, or splits it into its smallest factor and the rest; 0 stops.

examples.title: Guess my letter
examples.description: The //e picks a letter from A to Z; press letter keys and it answers earlier or later in the alphabet until you hit it, then counts your guesses.

manuals.title: Applesoft BASIC Programmer's Reference Manual, Volumes 1 and 2 (for the //e)
